gen-fs-oswald-gf-kumbh-sans: Oswald packs its letters into tight, tall rows. Kumbh Sans follows with short-cut terminals and a pen-steady line, so paragraphs of it move along smoothly and without fuss.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lato: Confident from the first line, Oswald stacks its narrow capitals tight, while Lato's wide s curves barely curl in and give the body room. Strength up top, ease below.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-libre-franklin: Libre Franklin reads as a plain sans, its splayed c terminal giving each line a quiet, steady rhythm. And Oswald does the loud work of tightly knit, strong headings, leaving the body to carry the sentences.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-livvic: Livvic reads friendly and open, with curves that carry no stress and a generous opening in every c. Oswald takes the strong stance; Livvic does the talking.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lunasima: Oswald's tightly knit rows give it a confident, compressed punch. Lunasima, a plain sans with c tips that never creep toward touching, can go a touch larger in the body if the text feels dense.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-m-plus-1: Confident Oswald holds the top with low, tightly knit letters like a firm handshake. M PLUS 1 follows with big open eyes and a neon-glass tube stroke, so nudge the body size up and let it breathe.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-m-plus-1p: Strong and tightly knit, Oswald sets a firm tone. M PLUS 1p, a clean sans with openness at every curve end, could use a slightly larger size to let those curves show.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 is friendly and professional, with a gaping c and strokes like thin plastic tubing bent in a loop. And Oswald's strong, tightly knit heading is the pair's sharpest quality, against that soft plain sans body.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Oswald is confident and low, built in tightly knit rows. M PLUS Code Latin pours neon-tube strokes of constant width into a sans body, each c with a wide pitcher mouth, so a long page feels smooth and approachable.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: M PLUS Rounded 1c reads friendly and plain, its terminals stopping short before they curl back in. Oswald's confident, tight rows lead, and the plain sans follows gently.
